claims.statement: The direct tensor-centered hidden remainder omega_{i<-j}-4 q_i q_j is nonnegative for every Boolean source.
claims.counterexample: Any two-bit non-affine Boolean function has q_i=q_j=1/2, r_ij=1/4, c_{i<-j}=1/2 and omega_{i<-j}=0, hence omega_{i<-j}-4q_iq_j=-1.
claims.scope: Intermediate tensor-centering rule only; not FEI.

claims.statement: With delta_ij=r_ij-q_iq_j, the exact pair mutual information I(X_i;X_j)=D_KL,2(P_ij||P_i tensor P_j)=Psi_{q_i,q_j}(delta_ij) is nonnegative and vanishes for exact cross-factor tensor pairs.
claims.scope: Every genuine Boolean spectral law; boundary cases by the standard KL limiting convention.

claims.statement: For a centered minimum-dimensional F/J ratio-critical core of ratio rho and every nonempty physical block A, TC(X_A)+rho C_A+W_A <= sum_{i in A}[h2(q_i)-rho q_i].
claims.scope: True ratio-critical cores under the TERMINAL_CORE restriction identities; all physical corrections retained.

claims.statement: For every forest T on a physical block A of a true ratio-critical core, sum_{ij in E(T)} I(X_i;X_j)+rho C_A+W_A <= sum_{i in A}[h2(q_i)-rho q_i]. Consequently (8/ln2) sum_{ij in E(T)}(r_ij-q_iq_j)^2 plus the same corrections is bounded by that surplus.
claims.scope: Every finite Boolean ratio-critical core and every forest on original coordinates. Exact mutual information is primary; the Pinsker square is only a corollary.

consumed_partner.applied_result: LOG-WEIGHT-NECESSITY-v1; it prevents promotion of the bounded quadratic Pinsker corollary into the universal logarithmic entropy payment, so the exact mutual-information/KL currency is retained.

next_unpaid_implication: Convert a genuinely obstructive signed complete-graph centered orientation contribution into a dimension-independent physical block/forest selection paid by the exact mutual-information ledger, or book the remaining cyclic dependence into another unspent block-information term, without free absolute values/positive parts or dimension loss.
